summary: Right-clicking a file in Windows 11 now shows AI shortcuts — remove background in Photos, visual search with Bing, AI actions in Teams and Paint. These can be turned off individually from the Apps settings.

steps.path: Settings → Apps → Actions → turn off each AI action toggle individually

collateral: toggles are per-action, not a single master switch — you must disable each one
whyTheyDidIt: Microsoft wants AI to feel like a natural part of the file workflow, not a separate app.

sources.label: MakeUseOf — I disabled all 10 AI features in Windows 11
